# About Us
Wondering who we are and why you should trust us for your digital marketing needs?

## We Help Businesses Thrive Online
In today’s market, businesses large and small must be highly visible on search engines like Google, Bing, and Yahoo as well as have a steady presence on the major social media platforms all while maintaining a great reputation online.

##### Increase Your Leads
Drive new prospects and incoming business through top search engine placement in sites like Google, Bing, and Yahoo.

##### Build Your Web Presence
Your website matters. We help our clients improve their existing websites or build brand new mobile-ready websites that help convert *users* into *customers*.

##### Connect Through Social Media
We create an engaging and fun social media presence for your business that focuses on driving customers while building your credibility on Facebook, Twitter, and other platforms.

##### Protect Your Reputation
We make sure you look great online by managing and monitoring search results including online review sites like Yelp, Google Maps, Bing Places, and others. Our team is always working to proactively build you a wall of positive results across all of the major review platforms.

##### Monitor and Report Your Progress
We want you to know how things are going at all times. When you work with us, you will have access to our proprietary Control Tower dashboard that lets you monitor all of the essentials for your marketing campaign including website traffic analytics, ad campaign reports, and much more!

## Why Choose Us
Search Control has an amazing team of talented individuals that have built thousands of usable websites for over a decade. Which means we are really old and wise in web years!

Our team has won many awards for our past work and we truly understand what it takes for a business to succeed online. Everyone on our staff works for you and we think you will be able to tell we are passionate about our results.

## Our Approach
Getting to know and understand your business isn’t a cliché, it’s a requirement. We use detailed yet painless questionnaires to help get the right information from you to allow us to market your business effectively.

#### OUR GOAL IS TO GET MORE CLIENTS & SELL MORE SERVICES FOR YOUR PRACTICE!
Get a **No Obligation Marketing Proposal** with a clear plan on how to increase sales and hit marketing goals and grow your brand!
